draft_body: At 10:00 today the courier capsule was ready for dispatch.

chapters.chapter_body: The courier capsule is ready only when its pressure is four bars and its valve cap is locked.

chapters.chapter_body: At 10:00 today the courier capsule pressure is four bars, but its cap remains loose and unlocked throughout that minute.
